# Glossary: Dutch CUF-XML names

CUF-XML uses Dutch element and attribute names; pycuf's model uses English ones. This page maps every element to its class and every attribute to its field, with a short description. Required attributes are marked with ✱.


## `CUF` → `CufFile`

The document: project data, sort-code schemes, the estimate and the tail.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AANMAAKDATUMTIJD` ✱ | `created` | datetime | Date and time the CUF file was written. |

Child elements: `PROJECTGEGEVENS`, `SORTEERCODES`, `BEGROTING`, `STAARTGEGEVENS`.

## `PROJECTGEGEVENS` → `Project`

General data about the project and the estimate.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CUF_VERSIE` ✱ | `cuf_version` | enum | CUF-XML version of the file; always 4.003 for this version. |
| `SYSTEEMHUIS` | `software_house` | enum | Vendor of the software that wrote the file. |
| `AANMAAKDATUM` ✱ | `estimate_date` | date | Date the estimate was created in the estimating software. |
| `PROJECTNUMMER` | `number` | string | Project number. |
| `PROJECTNAAM` | `name` | string | Project name. |
| `CALCULATOR` | `estimator` | string | Person who made the estimate. |
| `OPDRACHTGEVER` | `client` | string | Client who commissions the work. |
| `ADRESGEGEVENS` | `address` | string | Location of the building site. |
| `PROJECTSTARTDATUM` | `start_date` | date | Start date of construction. |
| `VALUTA` ✱ | `currency` | enum | Currency of all amounts (ISO 4217 code). |
| `EURO_KOERS` | `euro_rate` | number | Units of the currency that equal one euro. |
| `VRIJE_TEKST` | `notes` | string | Additional free text. |

## `SORTEERCODES` → `SortCodeScheme`

Declares one sort-code scheme used in the estimate, optionally with its codes.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SORTERING` ✱ | `name` | string | Name of the scheme (PLANCODE, ADMICODE, …). |
| `FUNCTIE` | `purpose` | string | What the scheme is used for. |

Child elements: `SORTEERCODE_REGEL`.

## `SORTEERCODE_REGEL` → `SortCodeEntry`

One code of a sort-code scheme.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CODE` | `code` | string | The sort code. |
| `OMSCHRIJVING` | `description` | string | Description of the code. |
| `EENHEID` | `unit` | string | Unit of the reference quantity. |
| `TERUGDEEL_HOEVEELHEID` | `reference_quantity` | number | Quantity of this code in the estimate, for unit rates (informative). |

## `SORTEERCODE` → `SortCode`

Assigns a sort code of one scheme to a bundle, line or resource line.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SORTERING` ✱ | `scheme` | string | Name of the scheme the code belongs to. |
| `WAARDE` | `value` | string | The sort code. |

## `HOEVEELHEDENSTAAT_REGEL` → `QuantityLine`

A quantity take-off line explaining where a quantity comes from (informative).

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUIMTE_NAAM` | `room` | string | Room or location of the measured part. |
| `OMSCHRIJVING` | `description` | string | Description of the measurement. |
| `AANTAL` | `count` | number | Number of times the part occurs. |
| `LENGTE` | `length` | number | Length. |
| `BREEDTE` | `width` | number | Width. |
| `HOOGTE` | `height` | number | Height. |
| `FACTOR_1` | `factor_1` | number | Multiplier, e.g. a unit conversion. |
| `FACTOR_2` | `factor_2` | number | Second multiplier. |

## `MAMO_REGEL` → `ResourceLine`

A resource line (MAMO): breaks an estimate line down into one cost type.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `KOSTENSOORT` ✱ | `cost_type` | enum | Cost type: LOON, MATERIAAL, MATERIEEL, ONDERAANNEMING or OVERIG. |
| `CODE` | `code` | string | Resource code. |
| `OMSCHRIJVING` | `description` | string | Description of the resource. |
| `HOEVEELHEID_EENHEID` | `unit` | string | Unit of the quantity (m2, m3, st, kg, …). |
| `HOEVEELHEID` | `quantity` | number | Quantity; empty or missing counts as 0. |
| `AANTAL_EENHEID` | `count_unit` | string | Unit of the count (often pieces). |
| `AANTAL` | `count` | number | Number deployed, for time-bound costs (count × duration = quantity; informative). |
| `INZET_EENHEID` | `duration_unit` | string | Unit of the duration (weeks, days, …). |
| `INZET` | `duration` | number | Length of the period deployed (informative). |
| `PRODUCTIE_EENHEID` | `production_unit` | string | Unit of the production rate. |
| `PRODUCTIE` | `production` | number | Production rate relative to the estimate line (informative). |
| `PRIJS` | `price` | number | Unit price (cost types other than LOON). |
| `PRIJS_FACTOR` | `price_factor` | number | Multiplier on the price or hourly rate (1.10 = 10% surcharge). |
| `FACTORCODE` | `factor_code` | string | Code of the price factor. |
| `UUR_NORM` | `hours_per_unit` | number | Labour hours per unit (LOON). |
| `UUR_TARIEF` | `hourly_rate` | number | Hourly rate (LOON). |
| `UUR_TARIEFCODE` | `hourly_rate_code` | string | Code of the hourly rate. |
| `EAN_CODE` | `ean_code` | string | EAN (GTIN) barcode of the article. |
| `ARTIKELGROEP` | `article_group` | string | Article group code. |
| `BESTELEENHEID` | `order_unit` | string | Unit in which the article is ordered. |
| `HOEVEELHEIDPEREENHEID` | `quantity_per_order_unit` | number | Number of units per order unit. |
| `LEVERANCIERSCODE` | `supplier_code` | string | Supplier code. |
| `COMMENTAAR` | `comment` | string | Free-text comment. |

Child elements: `HOEVEELHEDENSTAAT_REGEL`, `SORTEERCODE`.

## `BEGROTINGSREGEL` → `Line`

An estimate line: a quantity with unit prices for up to five cost types.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CODE` | `code` | string | Line code (does not define the hierarchy). |
| `OMSCHRIJVING` | `description` | string | Description of the work. |
| `HOEVEELHEID_EENHEID` | `unit` | string | Unit of the quantity (m2, m3, st, kg, …). |
| `HOEVEELHEID` | `quantity` | number | Quantity; empty or missing counts as 0. |
| `AANTAL_EENHEID` | `count_unit` | string | Unit of the count (often pieces). |
| `AANTAL` | `count` | number | Number deployed, for time-bound costs (count × duration = quantity; informative). |
| `INZET_EENHEID` | `duration_unit` | string | Unit of the duration (weeks, days, …). |
| `INZET` | `duration` | number | Length of the period deployed (informative). |
| `PRODUCTIE_EENHEID` | `production_unit` | string | Unit of the production rate. |
| `PRODUCTIE` | `production` | number | Production rate relative to the parent bundle (informative). |
| `HOEVEELHEID_FACTOR` | `quantity_factor` | number | Multiplier on the quantity (1.10 = 10% waste); empty counts as 1. |
| `FACTORCODE` | `factor_code` | string | Code of the quantity factor. |
| `UUR_NORM` | `hours_per_unit` | number | Labour hours per unit. |
| `UUR_TARIEF` | `hourly_rate` | number | Hourly rate. |
| `UUR_TARIEFCODE` | `hourly_rate_code` | string | Code of the hourly rate. |
| `MATERIAALPRIJS` | `material_price` | number | Material price per unit. |
| `MATERIEELPRIJS` | `equipment_price` | number | Equipment price per unit. |
| `ONDERAANNEMINGSPRIJS` | `subcontract_price` | number | Subcontracting price per unit. |
| `OVERIGE_KOSTEN` | `other_price` | number | Other costs per unit. |
| `STELPOST` | `provisional_sum` | boolean | Whether the line is a provisional sum (stelpost). |
| `BTW` ✱ | `vat_rate` | number | VAT percentage for the line and everything below it. |
| `EAN_CODE` | `ean_code` | string | EAN (GTIN) barcode of the article. |
| `ARTIKELGROEP` | `article_group` | string | Article group code. |
| `BESTELEENHEID` | `order_unit` | string | Unit in which the article is ordered. |
| `HOEVEELHEIDPEREENHEID` | `quantity_per_order_unit` | number | Number of units per order unit. |
| `LEVERANCIERSCODE` | `supplier_code` | string | Supplier code. |
| `COMMENTAAR` | `comment` | string | Free-text comment. |

Child elements: `HOEVEELHEDENSTAAT_REGEL`, `MAMO_REGEL`, `SORTEERCODE`.

## `BUNDELING` → `Bundle`

A bundle: groups lines and bundles (chapter, paragraph or element).

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CODE` | `code` | string | Bundle code (does not define the hierarchy). |
| `CODERING_METHODE` | `coding_method` | string | Coding system of the code (NLSFB, Bouwdelen, …). |
| `OMSCHRIJVING` | `description` | string | Description of the bundle. |
| `EENHEID` | `unit` | string | Unit of the reference quantity and multiplier. |
| `TERUGDEEL_HOEVEELHEID` | `reference_quantity` | number | Quantity of the bundle, for a unit rate (informative). |
| `DOORREKEN_HOEVEELHEID` | `multiplier` | number | Element quantity that multiplies all costs below; empty counts as 1. |
| `UREN` | `hours` | number | Total labour hours. |
| `LOONKOSTEN` | `labour` | number | Total labour costs. |
| `MATERIAALKOSTEN` | `material` | number | Total material costs. |
| `MATERIEELKOSTEN` | `equipment` | number | Total equipment (plant) costs. |
| `ONDERAANNEMING` | `subcontracting` | number | Total subcontracting costs. |
| `OVERIGE_KOSTEN` | `other` | number | Total other costs. |
| `COMMENTAAR` | `comment` | string | Free-text comment. |

Child elements: `BUNDELING`, `BEGROTINGSREGEL`, `HOEVEELHEDENSTAAT_REGEL`, `SORTEERCODE`.

## `BEGROTING` → `Estimate`

The estimate: direct costs excluding markups and VAT, as a tree of bundles.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `UREN` ✱ | `hours` | number | Total labour hours. |
| `LOONKOSTEN` ✱ | `labour` | number | Total labour costs. |
| `MATERIAALKOSTEN` ✱ | `material` | number | Total material costs. |
| `MATERIEELKOSTEN` ✱ | `equipment` | number | Total equipment (plant) costs. |
| `ONDERAANNEMING` ✱ | `subcontracting` | number | Total subcontracting costs. |
| `OVERIGE_KOSTEN` ✱ | `other` | number | Total other costs. |

Child elements: `BUNDELING`, `BEGROTINGSREGEL`.

## `STAARTGEGEVENS` → `Tail`

The tail (staart): markups and the contract sum.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AANNEEMSOM` ✱ | `contract_sum` | number | Contract sum including markups, excluding VAT. |

Child elements: `VRIJE_GROOTHEID`.

## `VRIJE_GROOTHEID` → `TailItem`

One tail item, such as overheads, profit and risk, or the VAT amount.

| Attribute | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OMSCHRIJVING` | `description` | string | Name of the tail item. |
| `BEDRAG` ✱ | `amount` | number | Amount of the tail item. |
